goal: Prevent local cross-user RPC credential theft when another process occupies the default IPv4 loopback port
Require the default IPv4 loopback bind to succeed during startup before writing the RPC cookie
agreement: Broad agreement on requiring an IPv4 listener since bitcoin-cli defaults to IPv4 (winterrdog)
Concept approval without extensive rationale (janb84, l0rinc, sedited)
Suggestions regarding error messaging and log levels were addressed or deferred without blocking

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it resolves a security flaw where bitcoind fails open on partial endpoint binds
Prevents rogue local processes on IPv4 from capturing plaintext cookies sent by default CLI tools
